name: fanvue
description: Connect Fanvue to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Fanvue MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Fanvue to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with creator account insights using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Fanvue workspace.
Find anything in Fanvue that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review creator account insights in Fanvue.
